body.prompt: Photorealistic contemporary scene in a Chicago office at night, cool neutral light, desaturated: an American man in his fifties sitting alone at a desk, looking down at a smartphone on the desk, screen not visible, mouth closed, face fully visible. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame.
